title: 木兰花慢·滁州送范倅
title_en: Mu Lan Hua Man: Seeing Off Deputy Fan at Chuzhou
author: 辛弃疾

form.en: ci to the tune Mu Lan Hua Man, in two stanzas

readings.en: In cháo tiān, to go and see the emperor, this character is read cháo.

readings.zh: “教”在这里是让、使的意思，现在课本里这种用法一般读 jiào（如“不教胡马度阴山”）。也有人读 jiāo。
readings.en: Here this character means to let or have someone do. Textbooks usually read it jiào in this sense. Some read it jiāo.

readings.zh: “泥酒”是贪酒、离不开酒，“泥”读 nì，是缠住、沉迷的意思。
readings.en: In nì jiǔ, to be hooked on wine, this character is read nì, meaning to cling to.

glosses.zh: 情味：兴致，对生活的热情。
glosses.en: qíng wèi: zest, the joy of living.
qiè: to fear.

glosses.zh: 流年：像水一样流走的时光。
glosses.en: liú nián: time flowing away like water.
kuàng: what is more.

glosses.zh: 屈指：弯着手指数日子，指算来很快就到。
glosses.en: qū zhǐ: counting on one's fingers; it is coming soon.
shí fēn: completely, perfectly.

glosses.zh: 不照人圆：月亮圆了，却照不到人团圆。
glosses.en: bù zhào rén yuán: the moon is round, but it does not shine on people reunited.

glosses.zh: 共西风：和秋风一起。西风就是秋风。
glosses.en: gòng xī fēng: together with the west wind, which is the autumn wind.

glosses.zh: 只等：只顾着。有的本子作“只管”。
glosses.en: zhǐ děng: only cares to. Some editions have a word meaning the same.

glosses.zh: 莼鲈：莼菜和鲈鱼。晋代张翰在外做官，秋风起时想起家乡的莼菜羹和鲈鱼，就辞官回家了。后来用它代指思乡、回家。
glosses.en: chún lú: water shield and perch. In the Jin dynasty, Zhang Han, serving far from home, missed the water shield soup and perch of his hometown when the autumn wind rose, so he quit and went home. It came to mean longing for home.
zhēng shān: travelling clothes.
biàn hǎo: it is just the time to.
cháo tiān: to go to the capital and see the emperor.
yù diàn: the jade palace; the court.

glosses.zh: 思贤：想得到有才能的人。
glosses.en: sī xián: longing for able men.

glosses.zh: 承明：承明庐，汉代官员在宫中值班住的地方，这里指朝廷。
glosses.en: chéng míng: the Chengming lodge, where Han officials stayed on duty in the palace; here, the court.
shì cǎo: to draft decrees for the emperor.
què qiǎn: then sends you.
chóu biān: to plan the defence of the borders.

glosses.zh: 长安：本是汉唐的都城，这里借指南宋的京城临安（今浙江杭州）。
glosses.en: cháng ān: the old Han and Tang capital; here it stands for Lin'an, today's Hangzhou, the Southern Song capital.

glosses.zh: 寻常：平常，照旧。有的本子这一句作“道愁肠殢酒只依然”。
glosses.en: xún cháng: as usual. Some editions word this line a little differently, with the same meaning of being hooked on wine.
nì jiǔ: being hooked on wine.
yī rán: still the same.
mù duàn: gazing until it is out of sight.
qiū xiāo: the autumn sky.

glosses.zh: 响空弦：拉响没搭箭的弓弦。战国时更羸只拉空弦，就把一只受过伤的大雁吓得掉了下来。这里写自己空有本领，没地方施展。
glosses.en: xiǎng kōng xián: to twang a bow with no arrow. In the Warring States era, the archer Geng Lei brought down a wounded goose just by twanging an empty string. Here it shows the poet has skill but no chance to use it.

translation.zh: 人老了，对什么都提不起兴致，
translation.en: As I grow old, my zest for life fades.

translation.zh: 对着送别的酒，更怕时光飞逝。
translation.en: Facing the farewell wine, I fear the passing years.

translation.zh: 何况屈指一算，中秋就要到了，
translation.en: What is more, counting the days, Mid-Autumn is near.
The moon will be perfectly full,
yet it will not shine on us together.

translation.zh: 无情的江水什么都不管，
translation.en: The heartless river cares for nothing.

translation.zh: 只顾和西风一起送走你回去的船。
translation.en: With the west wind, it only waits to carry your boat away.

translation.zh: 秋天傍晚，你会在江上吃到莼菜和鲈鱼，
translation.en: On autumn evenings you will eat water shield and perch on the river,

translation.zh: 深夜和儿女在灯前团聚。
translation.en: and late at night gather with your children by the lamp.
It is just the time to go and see the emperor,
for the court is longing for able men.
I picture you at midnight in the palace,

translation.zh: 又被派去谋划边防大事。
translation.en: then sent to plan the border defence.

translation.zh: 京城的老朋友要是问起我，
translation.en: If old friends in the capital ask about me,

translation.zh: 就说我还是老样子，照旧贪杯。
translation.en: tell them I am the same as ever, still hooked on wine.

translation.zh: 我望着秋空里的飞雁，直到看不见，
translation.en: I watch the geese in the autumn sky until they vanish,

translation.zh: 喝醉的时候，只能拉响空空的弓弦。
translation.en: and when drunk, I can only twang an empty bowstring.

background.zh: 宋孝宗乾道八年（1172年），辛弃疾在滁州（今安徽滁州）做知州，也就是一州的长官。“倅”是通判，知州的副手。这位姓范的通判（一般认为是范昂）任满要离开，正赶上中秋前后，辛弃疾写了这首词给他送行。词里一面祝他回朝受到重用，一面也说出自己想为国家出力却没有机会的苦闷。
background.en: In 1172, under Emperor Xiaozong, Xin Qiji was the governor of Chuzhou, in today's Anhui. The word cui in the title means a deputy governor. This deputy, surnamed Fan (usually thought to be Fan Ang), had finished his term and was leaving, around the time of the Mid-Autumn Festival. Xin wrote this ci to see him off. He wishes Fan a great welcome at court, and also lets out his own frustration: he wants to serve his country but gets no chance.

author_note.zh: 辛弃疾（1140—1207），字幼安，号稼轩，历城（今山东济南）人。他出生时北方已被金国占领，二十多岁就带兵起义，后来回到南宋。他一生最大的心愿是收复北方，却常常被派去做地方官，不能上战场。他的词豪迈有力，也常带着壮志难酬的悲凉。
author_note.en: Xin Qiji (1140–1207) came from Licheng, today's Jinan in Shandong. When he was born, the north was already ruled by the Jin. In his twenties he led an uprising against them and then came south to the Song. His great dream was to win back the north, but he was usually sent to govern local towns instead of going to war. His ci are bold and strong, and often sad that his great plans never came true.

appreciation.zh: 开头说：人老了，兴致也淡了，对着送别的酒，更怕时光飞逝。偏偏又是中秋，月亮十分圆满，人却要分开。江水无情，只管和西风一起送走归去的船。接着他替朋友想象回家的温暖：秋天江上吃莼菜鲈鱼，夜里和儿女在灯前团聚。下片换成鼓励：穿上行装去朝见皇帝吧，朝廷正在寻找人才。想象你深夜被留下来起草诏书，又被派去谋划边防大事。最后他托朋友带话给京城的老友：就说我还是老样子，爱喝酒。望着秋空里的飞雁，喝醉了只能拉一拉空弓弦。这一句写出了英雄没处用武的苦闷，很有力量。
appreciation.en: He begins: as I grow old, my zest for life fades, and facing the farewell wine, I fear how fast time flies. It is the Mid-Autumn Festival, the moon is perfectly round, yet people must part. The heartless river only joins the west wind to send the homebound boat away. Then he imagines his friend's warm homecoming: water shield soup and perch on the river in autumn, and family gathered by the lamp at night. The second stanza turns to encouragement. Put on your travelling clothes and go to the emperor; the court is looking for able men. Perhaps you will be kept late at night to draft decrees, or sent to plan the border defence. Last, he asks his friend to carry a message to old friends in the capital: tell them I am the same as ever, fond of wine. Watching geese in the autumn sky, when drunk, he can only twang an empty bowstring. This last line shows a hero with no battle to fight, and it hits hard.
